messages:
Maya: quick sync — legal pushed back on ambiguous rollback clauses in the new tiering doc. they want a concrete 'gracepath' for committed customers after any price/limit change. can we sketch options?
Ben: we can do a time-limited grace window that preserves old pricing for committed volume (configurable per-contract). low-level: billing flag + per-customer pricing override.
Ajay: ops perspective — two viable approaches: 1) honor old pricing for X days and route metering to legacy rate; 2) issue a credit for the delta at invoice time. 1 is simpler for customers, 2 is simpler for accounting.
Olivia: sales will prefer #1 for renewals. enterprise customers will ask for longer windows (60–90d) in negotiation. small customers ok with credits.
Maya: launch criteria thought: policy doc + example contract clause, console toggle to set grace window per account, billing infra capable of honoring legacy rates, comms template for customers. can we estimate effort?
Ben: rough eng estimate: backend billing changes ~2w, console toggle + UX ~3d, e2e tests + deployment ~3d. depends on how many rate permutations we keep.
Ajay: accounting impact: need to track 'delta credits' if we do option 2. also need rollback metrics: number of accounts using gracepath, volume under legacy rate. I can add metrics to the billing dashboard.
Maya: tradeoffs: option1 = better UX, higher complexity in runtime pricing. option2 = simpler runtime, more reconciliation work and possible customer confusion.
Olivia: ask — can we add an exception flow for negotiated deals (> $250k ARR) to set custom windows? that's a common ask from AE team.
Ben: technically doable via account-level config. doesn't materially change timeline if scoped into initial work.
Maya: decision proposal: ship MVP = option2 (crediting) + a UI opt-in for accounts to enable option1 (legacy-rate) where sales requires it. that reduces initial runtime complexity.
Ajay: +1 from finance if we surface the credit rows clearly on invoices. billing-bot: added ticket BILL-423 to track crediting implementation in billing backlog.
billing-bot: BILL-423 created by Ajay — 'Committed-tier rollback/crediting: invoice delta credits + metrics'.
Ben: can we also add a short-term safety check: if too many accounts enable legacy-rate, we automatically flag a scaling review? we need guardrails.
Maya: yes — guardrail = soft cap of 50 accounts by default, escalate to PM/Eng if exceeded. I'll add to the PRD.
Olivia: i'll prep a sales-facing FAQ and sample contract paragraph. ping me when PRD is up.
Maya: action items: Ben -> backend estimate + spike (due EOW), Ajay -> invoice sample + metrics list, Olivia -> draft FAQ & clause. follow-up sync Thurs. :thumbsup:
